description: Get the latest available intraday reading for active U.S. listings (consolidated SIP: last trade, UTC timestamp, session freshness, bid/ask) and for Canadian listings named as MIC:TICKER on XTSE, XTSX, XCNQ or NEOE (e.g. XTSE:RY: last price in the listing's currency, refreshed about once a minute during the Toronto session). This needs a paid plan: for U.S. listings Pro receives real-time readings and Plus 15-minute-delayed ones; for Canadian listings both receive the same readings, real time for XTSE and XTSX and 15 minutes behind for XCNQ and NEOE (Delayed=true). The Free plan covers end-of-day data only and is answered with an upgrade note. Stale=true means the reading predates the session expected now and must not be reported as current. This tool does not backfill historical intraday bars after hours. Missing readings are listed explicitly. Use GetLatestClosingPrices or GetStockPrices for settled daily bars.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols (max 25): a bare ticker for a U.S. listing, MIC:TICKER for a Canadian one.
